t: 罗马国王塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯(Servius Tullius)为他战胜伊特鲁里亚人而庆祝他三次…
te: Servius Tullius, king of Rome, celebrates the first of his three triumphs for his victory over the Etruscans.
dz: 罗马国王塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯(Servius Tullius)为他战胜伊特鲁里亚人而庆祝他三次胜利中的第一个.
de: Servius Tullius, king of Rome, celebrates the first of his three triumphs for his victory over the Etruscans.
